basis: Seat only: Christoph Schuh, a Lakestar partner, is a director on ShareIQ, Inc.'s 2016 Form D (Berlin issuer, $3.0M sold). No round announcement, firm post, listing or fund filing names Lakestar; only vendor profiles list it as an investor, and a vendor page is not evidence. A partner's name on a filing with nothing naming the firm is not_member (Erik, 2026-09-28, the BCV ruling on seat-only rows). Raised at close as an open ruling.
